notes.title: THE STARFIGHTER PC Game Entered Into The GDWC 2023 Competition In Finland.
notes.notes:
THE STARFIGHTER PC game has been entered into The GDWC 2023 (The Game Development World Championship 2023) Winter Season competition in Finland. 

The game developer was invited twice to submit THE STARFIGHTER PC game to THE GDWC 2023 Winter Season competition in Finland.
